BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, and lemon juice for 1 hour.
Step 2: Grill or fry the marinated chicken until lightly browned.
Step 3: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until golden.
Step 4: Add pureed tomatoes, garlic, and ginger; cook until thickened.
Step 5: Stir in cream and adjust seasoning with salt and spices.
Step 6: Add cooked chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 7: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
Suggestion: Use less butter and cream or replace with yogurt for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cut paneer into cubes and lightly fry them; set aside.
Step 2: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until golden.
Step 3: Add pureed tomatoes, ginger, and garlic; cook until thickened.
Step 4: Stir in cream, spices, and salt.
Step 5: Add paneer cubes and cook for 5 minutes.
Step 6: Garnish with coriander and serve with naan or rice.
Suggestion: Use low-fat cream or yogurt to reduce calories.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook lentils with water, turmeric, and salt until soft.
Step 2: Heat ghee and temper with cumin seeds, garlic, and red chilies.
Step 3: Add chopped onions and tomatoes; cook until softened.
Step 4: Pour the tempering over the cooked lentils and mix well.
Step 5: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with rice.
Suggestion: Use olive oil instead of ghee for a healthier option.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak rice for 30 minutes and cook until 80% done.
Step 2: Sauté vegetables with spices in oil.
Step 3: Layer rice and vegetables in a pot, adding yogurt and fried onions.
Step 4: Seal the pot and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with coriander and serve hot with raita.
Suggestion: Use brown rice for added fiber and nutrition.

Ingredients: Kidney Beans, Onion, Tomato, Garlic, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak and boil kidney beans until soft.
Step 2: Heat oil and sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Step 3: Add pureed tomatoes and spices; cook until thickened.
Step 4: Mix in boiled beans and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rice or roti.
Suggestion: Replace oil with a non-stick spray for lower fat content.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Heat oil and sauté spices and chopped onions.
Step 2: Add diced potatoes and cauliflower florets.
Step 3: Stir in tomatoes and cook until vegetables are tender.
Step 4: Garnish with coriander and serve hot with roti.
Suggestion: Add peas or spinach for extra nutrients.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Blanch spinach and grind to a smooth paste.
Step 2: Sauté spices and onions in oil.
Step 3: Add spinach paste, paneer cubes, and cream; cook for 5 minutes.
Step 4: Garnish with butter and serve with naan or rice.
Suggestion: Use low-fat paneer and cream for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak and boil chickpeas until soft.
Step 2: Sauté onions, ginger, and garlic in oil until golden.
Step 3: Add pureed tomatoes and spices; cook until thickened.
Step 4: Mix in boiled chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or bhature.
Suggestion: Use olive oil instead of regular oil for better health.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate fish with turmeric and salt for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Sauté spices, onions, and tomatoes in oil.
Step 3: Add coconut milk and tamarind paste; simmer.
Step 4: Add fish pieces and cook until done.
Step 5: Serve hot with rice.
Suggestion: Use less coconut milk or replace with almond milk for a lighter option.
